statements.statement: The service was mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229)
The patient had recurrent episodes of palpitations
The patient had a personal history of transient ischemic attacks
The patient had a personal history of cerebral infarction
The service was ordered to evaluate for paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other significant rhythm disturbances
